name: Role matrix
reader_question: Which organisation plays which role, without implying how much money each provides?
relationship: Membership of organisations in roles; each mark is a recorded role, optionally qualified, never a quantity.
use_when: The reader needs to see roles and overlaps across organisations before any amounts
Roles are sourced facts that can be stated in a few words
avoid_when: The question is how much each party provides — use sources-and-uses or a flow pattern on one stated basis
Parties are linked by edges rather than shared roles — use a network or sankey pattern

data_contract.notes: One entry per role; null means no recorded role. Qualifiers must not read as amounts

units: No units. The count row totals organisations per role, never money.

editable: Native table: labels, qualifiers, count row, fills
not_data_bound: The role circles are native shapes positioned over the cells from fixed row heights; the count row is typed table text, not a formula

table_alternative: A two-column table of organisation and comma-separated roles.
variations: Criterion-matrix when cells are graded rather than held
Project-level matrix with one column per project
limitations: A mark records a role, not its size or duration
Eight organisations is the legible limit on one slide

excluded_alternatives.reason: Implies amounts and mixes unlike instruments in one scale
Implies relationships the role data does not record
